asset.name: Document submitted for review
asset.description: Sent to the person who submitted a document: its reference and the review route.
asset.subject: {{reference}}: "{{form.title}}" is in review
asset.html_body:
Your document is in review

Hi {{submitted_by_name}},

{{form.title}} ({{form.doc_type}}, version {{version}}) has been submitted for review. Route: {{route_name}}, about {{review_days}} days per review.

You will hear from us if a reviewer asks for changes. When every review is done, {{form.doc_owner_name}} is asked to sign it off.

{{reference}} · document review
asset.text_body: {{form.title}} ({{form.doc_type}}, version {{version}}) is in review. Route: {{route_name}}. Reference {{reference}}.
